settings.subtitle: Chat in plain language with an AI that reads your Homey, controls devices and builds flows.
settings.recommendedHint: FlowMind is tested with Claude and it is selected by default. Create a key at console.anthropic.com and paste it here. Every provider needs its own key; you pay that provider per use.
settings.keysHint: Keys are stored encrypted on your Homey and never sent back to this page. Leave a field empty to keep the existing key; use "Remove key" to delete it. The Base URL applies to the "OpenAI-compatible" provider (Ollama/Groq/local, or Gemini via Google's OpenAI endpoint).
settings.keyIsHomeyKey: This is a Homey API key, not an AI key. Paste it under "Homey API key" below. Nothing was saved.
settings.homeyKeyTitle: 🔑 Homey API key (needed to create flows)
settings.homeyKeyHint: Without this key the AI can read your system and control devices, but not create or edit flows — Homey does not give apps that permission. Create a key via my.homey.app → Settings → System → API keys and paste it here. It never leaves your Homey.
settings.homeyKeyStatusNone: No key set — the AI can read and control devices, but not create flows.
settings.homeyKeyStatusOk: Connected with your Homey API key — the AI can create flows. ✓
settings.homeyKeyStatusError: The saved key does not work:
settings.memoriesHint: The AI saves lasting facts and preferences here (e.g. "the nursery must stay at 19°C"). They are included in every conversation. You can also just tell the AI to remember or forget something.
settings.aiPickerTitle: Choose which AI model this conversation uses
settings.webTermHint: Full-screen terminal for desktop browsers, served by the app on your own network (LAN only). API keys never appear on it, but anyone with the link can control your home through the AI, so do not share it. Leaked? Make a new link: the old one stops working at once.
settings.webTermAfterHint: Opens in your browser. After the first time this address also works directly:
settings.webTermRotated: New link made. The old link no longer works.
settings.helpText:
Commands:
/clear — new conversation
/memories — show what I remember
/help — this list
settings.chatPlaceholder: E.g. 'Set the living room lights to 40%' or 'Create an advanced flow that…'
settings.thinking: FlowMind is thinking and performing actions…
settings.welcome: Welcome! Just type your request. FlowMind needs a key from an AI provider: add one under Settings (Anthropic is recommended). Type /help for commands.
settings.jobLost: The answer is no longer available — the app probably restarted. Please ask again.
settings.jobTimeout: The assistant took longer than 5 minutes. Please try again, or pick a faster model.
settings.chatBusy: FlowMind is still working on other questions. Wait for those answers first.
settings.chatRateLimited: Too many questions in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
